ai.title: Daft Punk’s Thomas Bangalter might be a robot, but even he’s not interested in AI music.
ai.description:
He’s continuing his post-helmet media whirlwind and stopped by the Chanel Connects podcast, where the topic briefly turned toward AI. “I’m not really interested in the creative usage of artificial intelligence,” he says, noting that part of the creative process is experimentation and discovery, “The number one goal of this process is surprise.”
[Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Etl79iuZxaU&t=1246s]
ai.title_cn: Daft Punk的Thomas Bangalter可能是一个机器人，但即使是他也对人工智能音乐不感兴趣。
ai.description_cn:
他继续他的头盔后媒体旋风，并在Chanel Connects播客中停止，其中的话题短暂转向了人工智能。“我对人工智能的创造性使用并不感兴趣，”他说，并指出创造过程的一部分是实验和发现，“这个过程的首要目标是惊喜。”
[媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch? v= Etl79iuZxaU &t =1246s]

ai.title: SK hynix commits USD 39.42 billion to expand AI memory chip fabs
ai.description: South Korean semiconductor manufacturer SK hynix Inc. has decided to invest approximately 54 trillion won (USD 39.42 billion) to construct new fabrication plants in Yongin and Cheongju to meet expanding memory demand driven by artificial intelligence applications.
ai.title_cn: SK hynix承诺394.2亿美元扩建人工智能存储芯片晶圆厂
ai.description_cn: 韩国半导体制造商SK hynix Inc.已决定投资约54万亿韩圆（394.2亿美元）在龙仁和清州建设新的制造工厂，以满足人工智能应用推动的不断扩大的存储需求。
